_about: The cups and international tournaments golboard's API serves, beside the club leagues in leagues.json. Their games come from English Wikipedia pages, one match box per game. pages: each page and what its boxes are: a fixed group (group, name), or groups read from the page's "Group N" headings within a division (groups: headings, division), with rounds from the headings when rounds is "headings" (Matchday 1...). teams: clubs or nations (nations by FIFA code, data/api/nations.json). tz and clock: the time zone the boxes give kick-offs in; without tz, each box gives its own UTC offset. zones: what each place leads to, for every group or only one division's. hosts: nations already in the finals as hosts; a host's group sends the host plus the best of the rest. tiebreak: as in leagues.json, plus h2h_away_gf and away_wins. A head-to-head rule counts only the games among the teams still level at that point. hide: teams never shown, by FIFA code: that nation, and clubs whose box carries that country's flag ({{fbaicon|ISR}}); their rows and games are left out, but every other team's record still counts its games against them (Salah, 2026-11-14).
